description: The fixed-form DEBUGGING LINE (indicator D in column 7) - the COBOL-85 debug module's lines, compiled only under WITH DEBUGGING MODE. ISO 6.2.2 lists no such fixed indicator at COBOL-2023. Owner decision kb/Work R61 (researched against GnuCOBOL's per-standard dialect files, debugging-mode: ok at 85, obsolete at 2002, unconformable at 2014): accepted at 85, OBSOLETE at 2002 (the obsolete-element warning COBOL0903), REMOVED at 2014 (COBOL0902, error strict / warning permissive, the pre-removal comment semantics kept). Medium confidence on the 2002/2014 edge (the ISO 2002 and 2014 texts are not in the repository). Recognized in ONE place, the fixed-form classifier of the 6.5 logical conversion (kb/Work PB1494); the 2002 floating spelling >>D is the row floating-debugging-indicator-2002 (kb/Work PB4298). The WITH DEBUGGING MODE clause and USE FOR DEBUGGING keep their own rows.
citation: ISO 6.2.2 (no D indicator at 2023); §1985:VI.4.3.4 GR4 (debugging lines, REMOVED); obsolete 2002, removed 2014
vcr: VCR rows 7.9 and 7.17 (the debug facility); kb/Work R61
